references.text: In Genesis 46:21, the sons of Benjamin are mentioned, including Muppim and Huppim, which correspond to Shupham and Hupham in this genealogy of Benjamin's descendants.
The previous verse in the same section deals with the families and descendants of Benjamin in the census.
In 1 Chronicles 7:12, Shuppim and Huppim are mentioned as descendants of Ir, showing a parallel lineage to the tribe of Benjamin.
In 1 Chronicles 8:5, Shephuphan is listed among the sons of Bela, which is a variant of the name Shupham in the family of Benjamin.
